summary: Skratch tests whether the new Aura hero Holfast can replace a maxed Inspiration 5 Lincos. Testing in Temporal Vortex shows that swapping Lincos for Holfast increased total Aura team damage from approximately 7.2B to 8.1B (and overall team damage by roughly 1B). Because Holfast's 20-second 30% Damage Up buff from his passive does not stack with Lincos's ultimate 30% Damage Up, running both together is redundant and Lincos becomes obsolete. Diantha remains essential in the lineup for Defense Down and utility, while Holfast serves as the primary offensive buffer and personal damage dealer.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Provides consistent 30% Damage Up via his passive/talent, channels Aura energy, and provides substantial personal damage along with random offensive buffs.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: His 30% Damage Up does not stack with Holfast's passive, rendering even an Inspiration 5 copy obsolete in top-tier Aura comps.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Carries team damage output completely in fast dungeon runs and Temporal Vortex regardless of secondary support choices.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Should not be removed for Holfast because she provides Defense Down and essential utility.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Used as the frontline support for shields and team survivability in Temporal Vortex.

teams.note: Aura team setup that outdamaged the Lincos variation by almost 1 billion damage, dealing over 8B Aura damage.
Fast 15-second dungeon clear team; swapped between Holfast and Lincos with nearly identical clear speeds due to Talethia's heavy carry.

meta_changes: Holfast replaces Lincos in high-end Aura compositions because his passive 30% Damage Up buff does not stack with Lincos's ultimate buff.
tips: Prioritize Skill Haste on Holfast so his battle skill procs more frequently to distribute offensive buffs faster.
Do not remove Diantha when slotting in Holfast; replace Lincos instead to retain Defense Down debuffs.
Equip Holfast with full mythical DPS gear or Puppeteer set to maximize his personal damage contributions.
